build_math_shepherd_dataset: build a processed Math-Shepherd dataset for stepwise supervision training with TRL
create_script_arguments: create ScriptArguments dataclass with push_to_hub, repo_id, and dataset_num_proc fields
process_example: process a Math-Shepherd example by splitting inputs into prompt, completions, and correctness labels
run_dataset_processing: run dataset processing to map, split, and optionally push Math-Shepherd to Hugging Face Hub
generate_model_card: generate a ModelCard for the Math-Shepherd dataset with summary, data structure, and generation script info
